title: Twisted: The Untold Story of a Royal Vizier
original_title: Twisted: The Untold Story of a Royal Vizier
overview: Sherrezade presents a Magic Kingdom that prospered for many years thanks to its commitment to "the two Ds: duty and devotion". Following a period of prosperity, the Kingdom fell into the hands of a corrupt sultan and entered a dark age. The only man who can rescue the Kingdom is the misunderstood royal vizier Ja'far.
